;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]; [[Afghan peace process]]
**A [[Taliban]] spokesman says that the group has recalled its [[Negotiation|negotiators]] with the [[Afghan government|government]] in response to the latter's refusal to release Taliban prisoners. The Taliban also announces it could increase violence against [[Afghan Armed Forces|government forces]]. In response, the government asks the Taliban not to "sabotage the process". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-afghanistan-taliban/taliban-recalls-negotiators-from-afghanistan-after-suspending-prisoner-exchange-talks-idUSKBN21P2OU?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A major [[Power outage|blackout]] is reported in western and southern [[Libya]], according to the General Electricity Company of Libya, which says its control teams are trying to figure out the reason behind the power outage. [https://www.libyaobserver.ly/news/total-blackout-west-and-south-libya-gecol-says (''Libya Observer'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****[[Prime Minister of Japan|Prime Minister]] [[Shinzo Abe]] declares a [[state of emergency]] to combat [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://apnews.com/b4c774ef3b14b923e5be6acd01613487 (Associated Press)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****[[2020 Luzon enhanced community quarantine]]
*****[[President of the Philippines|President]] [[Rodrigo Duterte]] extends the lockdown and home [[quarantine]] measures on [[Luzon]] until April 30. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-philippines/philippines-extends-coronavirus-lockdown-home-quarantine-to-end-april-idUSKBN21P09F (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Lebanon]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on prisons]]
****A riot breaks out at [[Qubbah prison]] in [[Tripoli District, Lebanon|Tripoli]], [[Lebanon]], with reports of a "number of injuries". In a separate incident, Lebanese security forces thwart a mass escape attempt at a prison in [[Beqaa Governorate]], which relatives of inmates say is linked to fears of COVID-19. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/04/lebanon-prisons-hit-unrest-coronavirus-fears-200407181016398.html (Al Jazeera)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[Department of Health and Social Care]] reports 854 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, bringing the UK's death toll to 6,159 and 55,242 confirmed cases. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2020/apr/07/uk-records-highest-daily-death-toll-from-coronavirus-854 (''The Guardian'')]
***[[Republic of Artsakh|Officials]] in the breakaway region of [[Nagorno-Karabakh]] report its first confirmed case of COVID-19, a patient who had recently returned from [[Armenia]]. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/azerbaijans-breakaway-nagorno-karabakh-region-reports-first-coronavirus-case-2 (''National Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports 1,417 more deaths from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the country to date, raising the country's death toll to 10,238. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-france-reels-as-deaths-pass-10-000-11970183 (Sky News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)|COVID-19 pandemic in New York]]
*****[[New York (state)|New York]] Governor [[Andrew Cuomo]] reports 731 more deaths in the state from COVID-19, the highest daily death toll in the state to date, bringing the state's death toll to 5,489 and 138,836 infections. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-52205118 (BBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Catholic Church sexual abuse cases in Australia]]
**[[George Pell]] wins his appeal in the [[High Court of Australia]] against [[child sexual abuse]] convictions. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/04/06/australia/australia-cardinal-pell-high-court-hnk-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Corruption in Ecuador]]
**Former [[President of Ecuador]] [[Rafael Correa]] is found guilty on corruption charges and sentenced to eight years in prison. Correa is also banned from participating in politics until 2045. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-politics-ecuador/ecuadors-former-president-found-guilty-of-corruption-idUKKBN21P36D (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]], [[2020 Republican Party presidential primaries]]
**[[2020 Wisconsin Democratic primary]], [[2020 Wisconsin Republican primary]]
***Voters in [[Wisconsin]] go to the polls in their primary elections. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/04/07/politics/wisconsin-primary-coronavirus/index.html (CNN)]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic on USS Theodore Roosevelt|COVID-19 pandemic on USS ''Theodore Roosevelt'']]
**Acting [[United States Secretary of the Navy|Secretary of the Navy]] [[Thomas Modly]] resigns amid controversy surrounding his comments regarding Captain [[Brett Crozier]], former commanding officer of the [[aircraft carrier]] [[USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71)|USS ''Theodore Roosevelt'']]. Modly had referred to Crozier, whom he relieved of command on 3 April, as "too naïve or too stupid" to be in command following the leak of a letter the captain had sent pleading for help with the [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] outbreak on his ship. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/04/07/politics/modly-resign-crozier-esper-trump/index.html (CNN)]
*Former [[CNN]] contributor and [[press secretary]] for [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Donald Trump 2020 presidential campaign|2020 presidential campaign]] [[Kayleigh McEnany]] is appointed as the new [[White House Press Secretary]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/04/07/us/politics/kayleigh-mcenany-stephanie-grisham-trump.html (''New York Times'')]

;Science and technology
*Astronomers report, via ''[[The Astronomer's Telegram]]'', that [[comet]] [[C/2019 Y4 (ATLAS)]] appears to have disintegrated. [https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/gadgets-and-tech/news/atlas-comet-earth-sky-night-space-2019-y4-a9453611.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Donald Trump]] signs an executive order encouraging Americans to resist international restrictions on [[mining]] celestial objects, should the situation arise. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2020/apr/07/trump-mining-moon-executive-order (''The Guardian'')]
